writing:or:1.hint: 上着などを今すでに身につけている状態を表す動詞は何か。
writing:or:1.question: She [[wear]] a heavy coat in winter.
writing:or:1.fullSentence: She wears a heavy coat in winter.
writing:or:1.explanation: 状態動詞。「身につける」という動作は put on を使う。

writing:or:2.hint: 上着などを身につける動作を表す2語の表現は何か。
writing:or:2.question: He decided to put [[in]] his jacket before going out.
writing:or:2.fullSentence: He decided to put on his jacket before going out.
writing:or:2.explanation: 動作動詞。反対の状態は wear。

writing:or:3.hint: 疑問詞節の内容が判明する、という意味の2語の表現は何か。
writing:or:3.fullSentence: I need to find out what time the train leaves.
writing:or:3.explanation: 状況や情報が明らかになる動作を表す。

writing:or:4.hint: 電車やバスに今すでに乗っている状態を表す表現は何か。
writing:or:4.question: We are [[in]] the train heading to Kyoto.
writing:or:4.fullSentence: We are on the train heading to Kyoto.
writing:or:4.explanation: 状態(乗っている)。動作は get on。

writing:or:5.hint: 電車やバスに乗る動作を表す2語の表現は何か。
writing:or:5.fullSentence: She got on the bus at the corner.
writing:or:5.explanation: 乗る動作。降りるは get off。

writing:or:6.hint: 風邪をひいている状態を表す表現は何か。
writing:or:6.question: He [[have]] a cold and stayed home today.
writing:or:6.fullSentence: He has a cold and stayed home today.
writing:or:6.explanation: 状態。風邪をひく動作は catch a cold。

writing:or:7.hint: 風邪をひく動作を表す表現は何か。
writing:or:7.fullSentence: I caught a cold last week after the rain.

writing:or:8.hint: 何かをすでにつかんでいる状態を表す表現は何か。
writing:or:8.fullSentence: He held the rope tightly during the storm.
writing:or:8.explanation: 状態的な用法。つかむ動作はget hold of。

writing:or:9.hint: すでに眠っている状態を表す1語の動詞は何か。
writing:or:9.question: The baby is [[sleep]] peacefully now.
writing:or:9.fullSentence: The baby is sleeping peacefully now.
writing:or:9.explanation: 状態。眠りに落ちる動作はfall asleep。

writing:or:10.hint: 眠りに落ちる、という動作を表す表現は何か。
writing:or:10.fullSentence: I fell asleep on the sofa while watching TV.
writing:or:10.explanation: 動作。眠っている状態はsleep/be asleep。

writing:or:11.hint: ある集団や場所に所属している、という意味の表現は何か。
writing:or:11.fullSentence: This book belongs to the school library.

writing:or:12.hint: 時間の経過によって、ある状態に変化するようになるという意味の表現は何か。
writing:or:12.question: She came [[for]] understand his feelings after years.
writing:or:12.fullSentence: She came to understand his feelings after years.
writing:or:12.explanation: come to Vで「~するようになる」という変化を表す。

writing:or:13.hint: 何かをした後で後悔している、という意味の表現は何か。
writing:or:13.fullSentence: He regretted that he had not studied harder.
writing:or:13.explanation: 後悔の内容をthat節で述べる。

writing:or:14.hint: 提案や意見に賛成しない、という意味の1語の動詞は何か。
writing:or:14.fullSentence: Many experts disagree with this new policy.
writing:or:14.explanation: 賛成しないという意味。refuseは申し出などを拒む場合に使う。

writing:or:15.hint: 考えや気持ちを言葉に出して伝える、という意味の動詞は何か。
writing:or:15.question: It is important to [[expres]] your feelings honestly.
writing:or:15.fullSentence: It is important to express your feelings honestly.
writing:or:15.explanation: 自分の考えや感情を表す動詞。

writing:or:16.hint: 時間を無駄にせず、何かをするために使うという意味の表現は何か。
writing:or:16.fullSentence: I spent an hour reading this novel.

writing:or:17.hint: 何かに良い影響や悪い影響を持つ、という意味の表現は何か。
writing:or:17.fullSentence: Sleep deprivation can have a negative effect on health.
writing:or:17.explanation: 影響を及ぼすという意味の表現。

writing:or:18.hint: 何かを誤って別の物だと思い込む、という意味の表現は何か。
writing:or:18.question: I mistook him [[to]] his older brother.
writing:or:18.fullSentence: I mistook him for his older brother.
writing:or:18.explanation: mistake A for Bで「AをBと間違える」。
